simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to צִיוֹן (H6724) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: צִיוֹן (tsîyôwn) means a desert First listed occurrence: Isa 25 5.

definitions.full: H6724. tsayon צָיוֺן noun [masculine] dryness, parched ground (on formation see Lag BN 204 ); — בְּצ ׳כְּחֹרֶב Isa 25:5 , ׳בְּצ 32:2 (|| עֲיֵפָה אֶרֶץ ; both in simile).
